description: SET OR CLEAR THE REGION a shot exports. The crop is a rectangle remembered beside the marks, NOT applied to the bitmap — so the edge can be pulled back out afterwards, by you or by the tester, and «a bit more on the left» never means «take the screenshot again». Pixels are image pixels, the same ones qa_screenshot maps and qa_shot_mark draws in. Pass no rectangle to go back to the whole picture. This is the difference between a screenshot of a page and evidence about one thing: a reader who is handed eight thousand pixels and told «it is visible here» cannot see it.

crop.description: In image pixels. Omit to clear the crop and export the whole picture again.

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab
